# Distribution

This directory contains prebuilt LabMate application binaries for supported Flipper Zero / Momentum Firmware builds.

## LabMate v1.3

- `labmate-v1.3.fap` — prebuilt external application package
- Target: Flipper Zero
- Firmware: Momentum Firmware
- API tested during development: 87.1
- File integrity: see `SHA256SUMS.txt` (SHA-256 checksums)
- Validation: 3.3 V self-loopback tests, not independent calibration

## LabMate v1.2 (previous stable)

- `labmate-v1.2.fap` — prebuilt external application package
- Target: Flipper Zero
- Firmware: Momentum Firmware
- API tested during development: 87.1

> LabMate is designed for 3.3 V GPIO signals only. Do not connect 5 V, 12 V, automotive, mains, or unknown-voltage signals directly to the Flipper Zero GPIO header.
